title: Homogeneity of corporate risk perceptions and systemic financial risk
core_idea: Use text mining on financial institutions' risk factor disclosures to extract firms' perceived risks, quantify the homogeneity of those perceptions within and across sectors, and examine how perception homogeneity and institutions' network positions relate to systemic financial risk.
tldr: The paper applies text mining to firms' risk disclosures to measure similarity in corporate risk perceptions and assesses how that similarity, together with financial network positions, is related to systemic financial risk.
